Staff Selection And Support

STAFF SELECTION CRITERIA:

☐ Voluntary participation only

☐ Previous experience considered

☐ Emotional stability assessment

☐ Cultural sensitivity/awareness

☐ Training completion verified

☐ Rotation of staff (not assigned repeatedly)

☐ Debriefing after task completion

☐ Access to counseling services

☐ Time off if requested

☐ Peer support program available

☐ Management check-in following day
